topic: Catalog Coverage Floor and Unobserved Movie Cold-Start Limitations
problem_statement: What are the structural bounds of unpersonalized popularity baselines in MoodGraph?
root_cause: Unpersonalized models suggest nearly identical items to all users, ignoring individual preferences and long-tail items.
solution_or_decision: Document verified limitation: POPULARITY_COUNT achieves only 0.50% catalog coverage at K=10 (recommending 310 movies out of 62,423), ignoring 99.5% of the catalog. Furthermore, 3,491 catalog movies without Train ratings are unscorable by popularity baselines.
evidence: Artifact m03_popularity_results.json records catalog_coverage_full = 0.004966 (310 unique recommended movies across 109,779 users).
